Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Hiring > Requisitions path; the configuration labels for candidate selection process and background check account (VAN000, VAN09); Cielo billing terms; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

A requisition is the request to recruit. It's built from a position, and it copies that position the moment you submit, so check the position first.

Vanderbilt's recruiting is outsourced to Cielo, which bills for every opening and every fill. Open only what you'll actually fill.

Use this whenAn approved position needs to be posted and recruited for.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle Recruiting. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Never select Unlimited openings.
  • Never use United States as the location.
  • New York: New York candidate selection process and account VAN09, every time.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Create a requisition

Use when: An approved position needs to be posted and recruited for. · System: Oracle Recruiting

  1. Check the position first.
  2. Open Hiring and click Create.
  3. Choose Standard and select the position.
  4. Requisition title: the posting title.
  5. Justification and openings.
    • Each opening is billed, and unfilled openings are billed at 50% to cancel.
    • More than one opening also goes to central finance for approval.
  6. Hiring manager and collaborators.
  7. Requisition type: Standard or Abbreviated.
    • Executive search is only for Cielo's executive search program. An outside firm (such as Korn Ferry) needs a PO requisition, not a recruiting requisition.
  8. Organization and primary location.
  9. Required details.
  10. Description: paste the position description.
  11. Offer info: workplace type.
  12. Attach the position description and pre-search memo.
  13. Configuration: candidate selection process and background check.
    • New York requires non-criminal checks before any conditional offer. The wrong process breaks that law.
  14. Click Save, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Never select Unlimited openings.
  • Never use United States as the location.
  • New York: New York candidate selection process and account VAN09, every time.
